verifications.claim: Spring generally occurs in March-May in the Northern Hemisphere.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Spring typically begins in March and usually lasts until May or June.'; R5: 'Meteorological spring began March 1'; R6: 'In the Northern Hemisphere, spring starts in March... spring can include parts or all of the months of March, April, May, and June.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly support spring in Northern Hemisphere spanning March through May, with some extension to June noted as typical.

verifications.claim: Spring begins with the vernal equinox around March 20th.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first day of spring 2026 is on Friday, March 20'; R3: 'spring equinox... first day of spring'; R4: 'spring equinox is on Friday, March 20'; R5: 'vernal equinox... on Friday, March 20th'; R6: 'spring begins with the spring equinox... March 20'
verifications.reasoning: All listed sources explicitly state spring begins at vernal equinox around March 20th.

verifications.claim: Astronomical spring officially begins on the vernal equinox.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: Sources directly define astronomical spring as starting on the vernal equinox.

verifications.claim: The vernal equinox is around March 20th or 21st.
